Adding the field is the owner's call, and it is what would let CAP.observe stop being deferred alongside `observations`.

uage is credited ONCE per window per expert, not once per HOP. FabricOut carries no per-hop selection record -- weights is the accumulated, renormalised distribution -- so the computed set is reconstructed as its top-chain_k, which is EXACT at the shipped depth0=1 and a union approximation above it. Closing it needs a per-hop selection count leaving forward (a FabricOut field or a re-earned Population slot), both changes to landed code.

spawn still ignores FAB_GROW and the soft cap at the moment it fires. grow_check now charges spawn births against the new_frac budget (fab.newfrac_spent_on_spawn), which is the half that can be closed from here; the other half is a soft_cap keyword on FAB.forward, a frozen-signature move.
